messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Action Plan Kickoff — Tidewell Evaluation & Decision Timeline

Hi Ilana —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, I’m setting up a short MAP (mutual action plan) to align goals, owners, and milestones so we have a clean path to your evaluation window and procurement decision. I’ve drafted a first-pass plan and attached it (Tidewell_MAP_v1.xlsx). Please review and let me know any edits.

High-level goals we captured:
- Validate Redwood Inference for triage-assist workflows in Radiology (latency <150ms median, inference throughput target 40 reqs/sec).
- Verify privacy and audit controls for PHI-handling (SOC2 items + VPC options).
- Produce a small pilot with 2 clinical use cases and success metrics for expansion.

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Week 1 (Jul 28–31): Stakeholder roster + access + kickoff workshop (1 hr) — owner: Tidewell champion
- Weeks 2–3 (Aug 3–14): Technical onboarding, data-connectivity smoke tests — owner: Marissa (SE)
- Weeks 4–5 (Aug 17–28): Pilot run, quality checks, and metrics collection — owner: Tidewell clinical lead
- Week 6 (Aug 31–Sep 4): Decision review & contracting alignment with procurement — owner: Ilana / Samir

Can you confirm: (a) the Tidewell stakeholders who should be on the MAP (names + roles), (b) whether that timeline is reasonable for you, and (c) if we should loop in security/compliance contacts now?

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick 30–45m kickoff workshop this week to finalize the MAP and access. I’m available Thu 7/30 10–11am PT or Fri 7/31 2–4pm PT — which works best?
2) I’ll update the attached spreadsheet with any changes and share a live Drive link.

Attaching: Tidewell_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft), NDA_signed.pdf (reference)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

Best,

Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0129

Hi Ilana / Priya / team —

Thanks — quick checklist for the initial smoke tests (minimal, pseudonymized):
1) Sample payloads (JSON) for the two radiology triage endpoints (no PHI fields — replace names with IDs).
2) SFTP or secure share with ~500 de-identified studies (DICOM pointers ok) — encrypted at rest.
3) Test user account credentials for a non-privileged clinician view (we can provide a read-only demo account).
4) Network egress IPs/ports (we’ll provide) and a VPN fallback if VPC peering not available.
5) A point contact for access requests (recommended: Tidewell IT ops) and expected SLA to provision access (target 48–72 hours).

I’ll add these to the MAP and include a short tech-run agenda for the kickoff (30m):
- 0–5m: Introductions & success metrics
- 5–15m: Connectivity & data format checks
- 15–25m: Quick demo of inference path and latency expectations
- 25–30m: Immediate next actions & owners

Also attaching a brief SOC2 summary and our network connectivity checklist to this thread (see shared Drive). Priya — if you want any additional documentation ahead of the kickoff, say the word and I’ll surface it.

Looking forward to Friday.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
